title: Pan-Seared Northern Irish Aubergine Skillet
description: A hearty breakfast dish featuring pan-seared aubergine, northern irish breakfast sausage, and a full english skillet.
instructions: Heat the resinous english butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced aubergine and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until tender.
Add the cooked northern irish breakfast sausage to the skillet and stir to combine with the aubergine.
Season with irish salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pan-seared aubergine and sausage mixture over the full english skillet.
Garnish with additional resinous english butter if desired.
